title: Hannah Zhao
gallery_text: Memorializing Little ST. James Island, redesign to collecting trash from Caribbean sea.

answers.interest: I really wanted to take a class that would expand my understanding of simulation and computational methods, particularly how they can be combined with AI and data visualization in architecture and design.
answers.suggestions: I’d be interested in tutorials on creating responsive simulations where a spatial model changes based on real-time data, such as human activity, climate, sound, or environmental conditions.
